thread:
incident-bot: ALERT: realtime p99 latency breach detected for /v1/generate (hosted). p99=2.45s (SLO=1.2s). Detector: realtime-p95p99. Dash: https://dash.redwood/s/alerts/rl-9abc. Paging @marco_oncall @priya @alex @mei_obs
marco_oncall: Oncall here, ack. Any immediate customer impact?
priya: Looking at the streaming dashboards now — spike starts ~17:12 UTC in us-east-1. p95 up modestly but p99 jumped. KV cache miss rate spiked ~7x, eviction count up.
mei_obs: Quick logs look like repeated KV miss storms from inference-rt pods -> many long-tail token fetches. sample: ```WARN kv_cache.go:142 evict entry key=ctx:session:*** reason=mem_pressure```
dana_support: Support seeing increased timeouts. ~12 customers reported slow/responsive streams, 2 escalations hit 504s in the last 10m. Customers on dedicated capacity unaffected so far.
alex: Probable cause = cache thrash after recent rollout + a few long-sequence requests. Shortlive mitigations: enable prefix/KV caching, route long-stream requests to fallback, and scale up burst capacity. I'll prep the rollback plan.
marco_oncall: Action list: 1) flip fallback routing for heavy streaming routes -> small-model variant 2) scale up us-east inference pool 3) impose short-term rate-limit on streaming-append. Priya/Mei please run steps 1/2. Dana, notify affected customers with ETA.
priya: Triggering fallback route now. Command: ```redwood route update --route "/v1/generate" --fallback-model small-v2 --priority 10```
mei_obs: Scaling Dedicated pool in us-east: ```kubectl scale deployment/inference-rt-us-east --replicas=18``` Doing cache warming after scale.
incident-bot: Update: fallback activated, pool scaled. Monitoring metrics...
priya: Quick metric check: KV miss rate dropping ~60% post-fallback, p99 trending down to ~1.5s. Still above SLO but improving.
dana_support: Notified affected accounts with interim mitigation note and expected timeline (investigation + fix in progress).
alex: Also initiating rollout rollback for the recent quantized variant that increased seq lengths. If p99 doesn't normalize in 15m we'll fully revert.
incident-bot: Metrics update (17:28 UTC): p99=1.35s, error rate down to 0.8%, streaming stalls reduced. Continue 30m watch.
marco_oncall: Good progress. Assign postmortem if stable. I'll stay on watch for 45m. Dana, please collect customer impact list for postmortem.
dana_support: Will compile and share in ~20m.
marco_oncall: Closing live mitigation thread for now — keep alerts open and reopen iff p99 > 1.3s or new timeouts. Thanks all.
